thread:
IncBot: :rotating_light: P1 triggered - surge of CUDA OOMs on decode/streaming cluster (us-west-2). error-rate spike + request drops detected at 10:12 UTC.
Sam B: I'm on the channel, pulling logs.
Oncall Eng: oncall here, looking at recent deploys and config.
Jamal R: stack traces show repeated OOMs in decoder loop, kernel: cudnnMalloc failing, then GPU reset.
Luis M: customer telemetry points to one API key generating very long chat loops — token counts ballooning.
Anika P: I think the new streaming-config rollout bumped server default `max_tokens` to 4096 earlier today. suspicious.
Sam B: can we confirm whether server-side validation is enforcing limits?
Oncall Eng: not currently for streaming, clients can set `max_tokens`. we'll need an emergency override.
Anika P: prepping a runtime toggle to force `max_tokens`=2048 and to abort generations >30s.
OpsBot: executing rollout: set `streaming.runtime.max_tokens.override=2048` on prod (canary -> full).
OpsBot: pods restarting with new flag (6/6 applied).
Jamal R: OOM rate is falling but node-17 still shows repeated container restarts and CUDA driver warnings.
Sam B: node-17 dmesg: `NVRM: GPU at 0000:41:00.0: RmInitAdapter failed! (0x24)` then kernel GPU reset.
Jamal R: killing all in-flight decode tasks >30s to free KV caches.
OpsBot: `kubectl exec --namespace=redwood -c runtime -- pkill -f "decode_stream" --older-than 30s` -> terminated ~1200 tasks.
Oncall Eng: draining node-17 from rotation, rescheduling pods to other nodes.
Luis M: created temporary routing rule: if decode latency >500ms route to quantized fallback model `redwood/decoder-qv2` to reduce memory footprint.
Sam B: routing rule applied. traffic switching looks stable.
Anika P: hotpatched a server-side request validator to reject payloads with token_estimate > 50k and content_size > 512kb. response code 413 now returned for rejects.
Jamal R: posting snippet of OOM log:
```
2025-11-13T10:14:12Z runtime[decode]: cudnnMalloc failed: out of memory (allocation 134217728 bytes)
2025-11-13T10:14:12Z runtime[decode]: GPU 0 reset by kernel, vram reclaimed
2025-11-13T10:14:13Z runtime[watchdog]: rescheduling task id=0x7fa3...
```
Luis M: CS impact: about 120k failed requests in last 30 minutes; primary impact to streaming/generate endpoint for one large enterprise customer and a handful of smaller tenants.
Sam B: created support ticket CS-8912, assigned to SEs for outreach and draft of mitigation steps for customers.
Oncall Eng: enabling concurrency cap per-node: max_concurrent_decoders=120 to avoid future localized OOM storms.
Anika P: also locking server default `max_tokens` permanently until we ship more robust early-abort heuristics.
Jamal R: after kill and routing changes, OOMs have dropped to near-zero; container crash count reduced.
OpsBot: post-mit metrics: request_drop_rate 1.4% (was 20%), OOM alarms cleared.
Sam B: good catch on the client runaway. follow-ups: 1) permanent server-side hard cap on streaming tokens, 2) per-key quota + burst protection, 3) improved telemetry to detect token-runaway patterns, 4) add early-abort in decoder when token-generation rate exceeds thresholds.
Luis M: I'll draft the postmortem with timeline, customer impact calc (SLA exposure), and action items.
Oncall Eng: handing off to daytime oncall @Sam B in 30m. marking incident as mitigated but keep watch for 2 hours.
Sam B: will own follow-ups and coord with Product/SRE/Support. thanks all :thumbsup:
IncBot: Incident paging disabled, watch-mode ON. please update postmortem within 72h and tag leadership.
